text.en: Each step looks at the last two Booth bits and decides whether to add the multiplicand to the accumulator, subtract it, or leave it alone.
text.es: Cada paso mira los dos últimos bits de Booth y decide si suma el multiplicando al acumulador, lo resta o lo deja igual.

text.en: Switch on `lsb_pair` with a `case`: `"01"` adds `m_ext`, `"10"` subtracts it, and `when others` (`"00"`/`"11"`) keeps `acc` unchanged.
text.es: Usa un `case` sobre `lsb_pair`: `"01"` suma `m_ext`, `"10"` lo resta y `when others` (`"00"`/`"11"`) deja `acc` igual.
